protocol_note: Candidates are evaluated through the existing registered economic_walk_forward_v1 protocol. The decision stream is emitted by the real native Rust strategy (mqk backtest native-signals); no trading rule is re-implemented in Python. Hypothesis != trial != attempt != evaluation slice: one hypothesis, one trial per fixed symbol, retries are new attempts of the same trial.

hypothesis.name: Long-only daily trend filter on a fixed five-asset-class ETF list
hypothesis.economic_rationale: Prices that trade above their own trailing average tend to persist (trend/time-series momentum), so holding the asset only while its last completed close exceeds its trailing 50-day mean should reduce exposure during sustained drawdowns relative to passive holding, at the cost of lagging in uninterrupted rallies.
primary_references: Brock, Lakonishok & LeBaron (1992), 'Simple Technical Trading Rules and the Stochastic Properties of Stock Returns', Journal of Finance 47(5):1731-1764
Faber (2007), 'A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation', Journal of Wealth Management 9(4):69-79
Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012), 'Time Series Momentum', Journal of Financial Economics 104(2):228-250
hypothesis.falsification_condition: A symbol's candidate is REJECTED if it fails any gate listed under rejection_gates. The campaign is rejected as a whole if no candidate clears every gate.

native_engine.lookback_rationale: 50 is the shortest window of Brock et al. (1992)'s canonical set and equals the backtest engine's default bar_history_len, so Backtest and Paper evaluate the same decision. It is fixed here and was not tuned; no other lookback is evaluated in this campaign.
native_engine.rule: target = +1 share if the last completed close is strictly above the integer mean of the trailing 50 completed closes (including itself), else 0

universe.selection_rule: The five asset-class proxies of Faber (2007)'s GTAA list that exist as enabled ETFs in config/instruments/equities.json: US equities, foreign developed equities, 10-year Treasuries, US real estate, commodities. DBC/GSCI is not in the registry; GLD is the registry's commodity proxy.
universe.survivorship_note: A fixed list of long-lived, still-listed ETFs is not point-in-time clean. Each symbol is its own registered trial and the judge deflates over all five, so selection among them is accounted for; residual survivorship of the list itself is a stated limitation.

experiment.seed_registry_rule: byte-identical file copy verified by sha256; campaign 02's own registry stays unmodified. No registry row is ever hand-written.
experiment.population_policy: The judge's population is every trial registered under real_experiment_id in the registry it reads (MultipleTestingJudge scope = experiment_id; hypothesis_id unset). Reusing campaign 02's experiment id in a copy of campaign 02's registry therefore keeps its five disclosed trials (one evaluable, four 'no_successful_attempt') in the population next to campaign 03's five. Campaign 01's five trials live in a separate registry and experiment id and cannot be pooled without hand-written rows; they are disclosed, not hidden.

fallback_if_corporate_action_gate_refuse.note: Boundary already established as corporate-action-safe by prior campaigns. Used only if the fail-closed gate refuses the primary window; declared now, before any result.

reuse_verified_data_from.rule: byte-identical reuse after verifying the provenance manifest artifact_sha256 and row_count against the CSV; no new provider call

partition.holdout_rule: last 6 calendar months of the dataset, reserved_not_evaluated, never consumed by this campaign
partition.warmup_note: Signals before 50 completed closes exist are flat by construction.

native_backtest.initial_cash_rule: USD 1,000 for every symbol, fixed now; one share of every listed symbol costs less than this over the whole window
native_backtest.bars: the same provenance-bound research bars converted deterministically, truncated at the holdout start

robustness.source_note: Reuses the finite values the Wave06 campaign already froze before its results; the notional cap is half the single-symbol long-only natural position (equity_usd x max_gross_exposure = 100,000).

scanner_review.policy: mqk_backtest::StrategyScanReviewPolicy::default (min_bars 252, min_trades 5, min_return_pct 0, min_alpha_pct 0, max_drawdown_pct 25, min_profit_factor 1.05) -- unchanged
scanner_review.data: the same discovery-only converted bars (truncated at the holdout start), one registry/bars root per campaign run

promotion_policy.note: No canonical production threshold values exist in the deployed configuration. These are fixed now, before any result, and are supplied to the daemon only for the promotion transition.

rejection_gates: economic evaluation fails or is insolvent
judge not evaluable (DSR/PBO) or DSR below promotion_policy minimum or PBO above maximum
any required robustness scenario fails or is not evaluable (canonical P9 gauntlet, genuine shuffled placebo, P7A/P7B stress, DSR/PBO block-count sensitivity)
any promotion_policy threshold fails in canonical evaluate_promotion

stopping_rule.no_further_amendment: forbidden: no campaign 04, no 25/40/60/75 percent notional, no adaptive sizing
stopping_rule.if_no_candidate_clears_every_gate: record REJECTED and stop; a different hypothesis needs a new operator decision
stopping_rule.infrastructure_failure: retry the same attempt/trial identity under the existing contract; an economic failure is finalized failed and never retried

attempt_identity_rules: A retry after an infrastructure failure is a new attempt of the SAME trial_id. trial_id derives from strategy_id, symbol, native semantic fingerprint, bars provenance, partition policy and economic protocol only.
forbidden_after_predeclaration: changing the symbol list, lookback, partition, costs or thresholds after seeing any result
defining identity from a result value
promoting any candidate by hand or outside the production transition route

execution_fidelity.metric: fraction of evaluated bars on which the simulated discrete share position (held before that bar's order) agrees, long vs flat, with the executed desired weight; positions only, never P&L
execution_fidelity.enforced_by: mqk_research.ml.native_signal_registry_integration.NATIVE_EXECUTION_FIDELITY_FLOOR; an attempt below the floor is finalized failed and kept

amendment.operator_decision: One final third specification of the trend_sma50 family at a half-equity notional.
amendment.campaign_02_disposition: unchanged history: four attempts failed the position-agreement gate, IEF succeeded, judge partially_evaluable, PBO not evaluable

changed_fields.economic_protocol.weight_to_share.max_po: 90000.0 -> 50000.0 (= campaign 02 equity_usd 100000.0 x 0.50). Sizing is identity-bearing, so every trial and economic identity changes.
changed_fields.robustness.p7a_p7b_stress.stress_max_pos: 50000.0 -> 25000.0. The stress cap must be strictly tighter than the baseline cap or the P7B adversity validator refuses the replay; it is set to half of the campaign 03 baseline notional. This is a consistency requirement, not a threshold choice.
changed_fields.run_dir / experiment.registry_db_relativ: new run directory and a copied registry (see experiment.seed_registry_copy_from)

unchanged: native engine, signal rule and lookback 50
promotion policy thresholds (frozen before campaign 01 and 02 results)
amendment.no_scale_invariance_claim: No statistic is carried over or assumed from campaign 01 or 02. Discrete shares, costs, slippage, running equity and fill refusals can change realized returns; every metric is recomputed from campaign 03's own evidence.
amendment.trial_count_disclosure: Fifteen trials in total are tested on this hypothesis family: five voided (campaign 01), five in campaign 02 (four failed the fidelity gate) and five here. The judge population for this campaign is the ten registered under the shared experiment id; campaign 01's five are disclosed above.
